title: Ridgeline Pro Credit Commercial Terms — Prompt-Payment Discount Figures by Tier
content:
A prompt-payment discount is offered on a Ridgeline Pro Credit tier only where the discount days below are above 0. The percentage is a percent of the invoice's merchandise amount.

| Tier | Discount (percent) | Discount days from the invoice date (calendar days) | Invoices priced under a ProBuild volume pricing quote excluded | Discount computed on sales tax too | Earned only with no past-due invoice on the payment date |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Pro Revolving Charge | 0.00 | 0 | Yes | No | No |
| Ridgeline Pro Revolving Charge Plus | 0.00 | 0 | Yes | No | No |
| Ridgeline Commercial Account Net 30 | 0.00 | 0 | Yes | No | No |
| Ridgeline Commercial Account Net 30 Select | 1.00 | 10 | Yes | No | Yes |
| Ridgeline Commercial Account Net 45 | 1.00 | 10 | Yes | No | Yes |
| Ridgeline Commercial Account Net 60 Enterprise | 1.50 | 15 | Yes | No | Yes |

## Reading the table

- Discount days of 0 mean no discount is offered on that tier, so the Pro Revolving Charge, the Pro Revolving Charge Plus and the Commercial Account Net 30 offer none.
- On every tier the discount is not computed on sales tax, and invoices priced under a ProBuild volume pricing quote are excluded.
- On the three tiers that offer the discount, it is earned only when no other invoice on the account was past due on the payment date.

Hypothetical illustration: an invoice on a Commercial Account Net 60 Enterprise with a merchandise amount of 4000.00 and sales tax of 300.00 has a discount of 1.50 percent of 4000.00, that is 60.00; the 300.00 of tax does not enter it.
